rationale: The agent verified the user by email before accessing account details. They retrieved the latest order details via tools, confirmed the specific item and refund method before making any changes, and then executed the return using the correct tool with the specified PayPal method. The tool response shows the order status updated to “return requested,” matching the agent’s confirmation. No fabrication or cross-account actions occurred. The agent provided appropriate final information about refund processing and return instructions. While the user initially mentioned “some items,” they narrowed the request to the gaming mouse, and the agent fulfilled that confirmed request properly per policy.
